message: refused: the file declares no CRS and none was asserted by the caller (no `geo` metadata CRS on the primary geometry column). GeoParquet's OGC:CRS84 default is applied only when the crs key is absent in a file of version 1.0.0 or 1.1.0; otherwise assert a CRS to open the file (docs/05, no silent conversion)
